reproducibility.notes: All three training runs (ml/baseline/train.py, ml/bilstm/train.py, ml/distilbert/train.py) share the same seed=42 data/processed split and select their final model/checkpoint using only validation macro-F1. The test split is scored exactly once, after the model is frozen, and only for reporting -- never for training or checkpoint selection.

selection.rationale: 'distilbert' has the highest macro_f1 (0.9979) among all candidates; no tie-break was needed.
